properties.name: Saharan Solar & Wind Zone
properties.description: A vast corridor from Dakhla to Ouarzazate with some of the world's highest solar irradiance (>2,500 kWh/m²/yr) and consistent Atlantic wind resources. Central to the Xlinks project, MASEN's pipeline, and green hydrogen feasibility studies by IRENA and CWP Global.

properties.name: Atlantic Wind Corridor
properties.description: A narrow coastal strip from Tarfaya to Essaouira with average wind speeds exceeding 9 m/s at hub height. Hosts the Tarfaya wind farm and multiple planned expansions under Morocco's Integrated Wind Programme. Capacity factors regularly exceed 40%.
